policy: Tests 'pinned'/« figé » de la lane D : ils PASSENT en encodant un état non corrigé. Jamais désactivés. Le jour où l'état change, re-baseliner l'assertion dans le même commit que le correctif et déplacer l'entrée ici vers 'closed'. Aucun skip/todo/expected toléré.
closed: tests/security/probes-growth.test.cjs — stores de session sans plafond : bounded() prend un max (2000, 10000 pour le registre de menus) et évince le moins récemment utilisé, assertion re-baselinée sur le plafond

tests/logic/dead-code.test.mjs — branche morte prouvée : le garde MAX_ENTRY_AGE_MS ne peut pas décider : la clause age >= e.ttl est retirée du sweep (fix stale-during-outage), une génération périmée reste servable jusqu'à 24 h, assertion re-baselinée sur la clause unique
tests/logic/dead-code.test.mjs — STATIC_TTL_MS (TTL fantôme 12 h) : constante supprimée, assertion re-baselinée à 0 occurrence
tests/logic/dead-code.test.mjs — census d'exports : 27 des 32 valeurs non consommées dans src/ ont perdu `export` ; 5 restent exportées car tests/ les importe
tests/logic/page-parser.test.mjs — parseGrades sans espace final (fixture à 11 cellules) : le test mono-cellule mappait cells[0]→date et attendait code
tests/logic/menu-pdf-parser.test.mjs — PDF muet : l'assertion demandait un menu non vide alors que le titre demande un refus
tests/logic/route-contracts.test.mjs — castelru : le 404 est désormais déclaré (notFound sans params)
tests/logic/route-contracts.test.mjs — declared502 : 10 → 11, POST /colles/group déclare son 502 (le 200 tout-null pendant une panne amont est corrigé en 502 nommé, même commit que le correctif)

tests/logic/print-client.test.mjs — listJobs : bloc sans data-job-id → ignoré (perte silencieuse, comportement figé) : correctif appliqué (erreur nommée au lieu d une perte/du 0 muet), assertions re-baselinées dans le même commit

tests/logic/print-client.test.mjs — listJobs : overview sans séparateur → toute la chaîne dans date, owner vide (figé) : correctif appliqué (erreur nommée au lieu d une perte/du 0 muet), assertions re-baselinées dans le même commit

tests/logic/print-client.test.mjs — getBalance : aucun correctif n'a été appliqué, getBalance/parseAmount (src/routes/print/utils/print.ts) renvoie toujours 0 pour un sélecteur absent comme pour un span vide, et le test « getBalance answers 0 when the selectors are missing, as the print site does, without a 500 » documente ce 0 muet comme le comportement du site d'impression ; les deux défauts restants (montant à groupe de points lu 0, span vide lu 0) restent figés à l'échelle HTTP dans tests/logic/upstream-routes-edges.test.mjs

tests/logic/page-parser.test.mjs — parsePartialViewState : absence → null (sentinelle « pas de mise à jour ») : correctif appliqué (l'absence et un jeton vide ne sont plus indistinguables), assertion re-baselinée dans le même commit

tests/logic/http-cache.test.mjs — coût d'un 404 CROUS : 1 appel amont par requête, la sonde de salle court-circuite le menu : correctif appliqué (amplification 1:2 bornée à 1 appel, aucun appel menu), assertion re-baselinée dans le même commit

tests/security/probes-growth.test.cjs — store de sessions d'impression sans plafond : correctif appliqué (MAX_PRINT_SESSIONS = 512, l'écriture évince la plus ancienne), le test s'appelle désormais « the print session store stops at the count cap and evicts the oldest account » et est re-baseliné sur le plafond
tests/logic/page-parser.test.mjs — assertComplete key-order : ROWCOUNT_RE lit rowCount indépendamment de l'ordre des clés du paginator et refuse aussi les tables tronquées à 0 ligne rendue
tests/logic/page-parser.test.mjs — parseChoiceRows code/type vides : CODE_SHAPE et TYPE_SHAPE exigent au moins 1 caractère non vide

tests/logic/aurion-parsing-edges.test.mjs — table de notes tronquée sans ligne rendue, table imbriquée dans une cellule de note, cellules de date d'absences à style quelconque ou doublon, CDATA malformé (]]>), espace largeur zéro dans un libellé et ligne de notes trop courte : corrigés et re-baselinés
tests/logic/menu-date.test.mjs — frLongDate valide désormais la longueur réelle du mois (années bissextiles comprises) sur tous les chemins et accepte l'ordinal 1er
tests/logic/menu-pdf-parser.test.mjs — page datée sans restaurant : refusée avec message dédié au lieu de renvoyer un menu sans restaurant

tests/logic/upstream-routes-units.test.mjs & upstream-routes-edges.test.mjs — castelru.ts délègue formatMenuDate à frLongDate, findmyroom.ts normalise salles/batiments/dispo/total et replie une heure illisible sur l'horloge de Paris, updates.ts trie les versions non numériques en dernier, print.ts accepte les attributs sur div.job et les séparateurs de milliers par point
tests/logic/admin-routes-print-census.test.mjs — collesGroupOf tokenise la classe du roster (MPI-K1 matche MPI) et withCollesGroups réutilise le cache rosterRows()
tests/security/probes-concurrency.test.cjs — revokeSessions vide aussi flowEntries/menuBodies/flights et incrémente epoch dans la clé de preheat

tests/logic/cache-layer.test.mjs — le garde d'âge n'est consulté qu'au sweep d'éviction, jamais en lecture ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (si le garde devient une borne de lecture, re-baseliner (le HIT à 25 h devient un MISS))
tests/logic/menu-pdf-parser.test.mjs — une mise en page inconnue et un menu vide sont indistinguables ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (distinguer les deux, puis re-baseliner)
tests/logic/menu-pdf-parser.test.mjs — les sections homonymes ne sont pas fusionnées ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (fusionner, puis re-baseliner)
tests/logic/menu-pdf-parser.test.mjs — le seuil h ≥ 38 écarte aussi une ligne de menu réelle ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (affiner le seuil, puis re-baseliner)

tests/logic/route-contracts.test.mjs — le corps d'erreur du framework n'a pas la forme { success, error } ; le schéma 400 déclare désormais statusCode/code/message (renommé : les messages rendus sont passés de français à anglais) ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (si le schéma 400 redevient strict, re-baseliner)

tests/logic/print-client.test.mjs — a login wall or a layout change is indistinguishable from an empty print queue ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (require a job-list sentinel, then re-baseline: a page without it must raise a named error)

tests/logic/palantir-daemon.test.mjs — publish() retries any failure, including permanent 4xx, six times with 30 min sleeps, burning about 2.5 h of the 4 h unit timeout ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (fail fast on 4xx other than 408/429, then re-baseline: one attempt)

tests/logic/aurion-parsing-edges.test.mjs — planning.ts (same pattern in palantir.ts) advertises the server's current UTC offset instead of the offset of the requested window, so a window in the other DST regime is sent an hour off ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (derive the offset from the requested window's date, then re-baseline: the advertised offset must match the window)

tests/logic/boot-fallbacks.test.mjs — index.ts leaves FST_ERR_BAD_URL out of FRAMEWORK_MESSAGES and the router replies before the handler, so a malformed URL (GET /%2) is answered with fastify's raw router message instead of the sanitised {statusCode, code, error, message} contract ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (map FST_ERR_BAD_URL in the framework handler, then re-baseline: the malformed URL must answer the sanitised body)

tests/logic/documents-edges.test.mjs — documents.ts drops a consulter row whose detail page renders no datagrid, while its category is still reported as a normal (ok) leaf with 0 documents ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (report the missing datagrid on the leaf, then re-baseline: the category must carry the error instead of looking normal)

tests/logic/documents-edges.test.mjs — documents.ts rejects a download POST answered with a 302 ("Échec du téléchargement (HTTP 302)") instead of following the Location, while the consulter path does follow redirects ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (follow the redirect like the consulter path, then re-baseline: the download must succeed)

tests/logic/documents-edges.test.mjs — documents.ts does not follow a 302 leaf response and session-manager.ts parses its empty body as a ViewState, so the leaf errors with "ViewState non trouvé" and its whole category disappears ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (follow the leaf redirect, then re-baseline: the leaf must be walked instead of dropped)

tests/logic/lacatho-menu-fetch.test.mjs — menu.ts's declared-length guard is unreachable with undici (a short body raises a TypeError caught outside, extra bytes are dropped), so a mis-declared length surfaces as 500 "Réponse amont illisible" instead of 502 ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (map a declared-length mismatch to the 502 branch, then re-baseline: a short PDF must answer 502)

tests/logic/lacatho-menu-fetch.test.mjs — menu.ts returns null on !res.ok without reading or cancelling the error body, so the upstream socket and its buffered body stay pinned until GC ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (cancel the error body before returning null, then re-baseline: the failed response must be drained)

tests/logic/menu-date.test.mjs — menu-date.ts always reads the d/m/y path day-first and only swaps when the second slot exceeds 12, so 03/04/2026 is fixed as 3 April and the other reading is unreachable ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (make the day-first reading explicit (a documented rule or an explicit format), then re-baseline: the same label must still read 3 April, never 4 March)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-edges.test.mjs — jobs-upload/route.ts only sees request.file() and @fastify/busboy drops the part whose decoded filename* contains CR/LF, so the caller sees 400 "Fichier manquant" as if no file had been sent ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (distinguish an unusable file part from a missing one and answer 400 "Nom de fichier invalide", then re-baseline: the status must be 400 with an explicit filename message)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-edges.test.mjs — print.ts marks the failure not retryable once the upload body has been streamed, so a lost SafeQ session answers 500 "Erreur amont" and the file body is never re-sent ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (answer 502/503 with Retry-After and a distinct message stating the file can be re-sent, then re-baseline: the status must be 502)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-edges.test.mjs — print.ts throws "Bloc d'impression sans identifiant" for a job block without a data-job-id and "Aperçu d'impression inattendu" for an overview without a separator, and the route maps both to 500 "Erreur amont" ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (answer 502 for a drifted page instead of 500, then re-baseline: the status must be 502)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-units.test.mjs — supabase.ts rethrows an unparseable body with status 200 attached, so sentry.ts respondDbError sees a non-upstream error and answers 500 "Erreur base de données" instead of "Réponse amont illisible" ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (detect a non-JSON body (or carry the parse flag) in respondDbError and answer 502 "Réponse amont illisible" with Retry-After 5, then re-baseline: the status must be 502)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-units.test.mjs — sentry.ts sets isUpstream only for status >= 500, so a PostgREST 429 (or 408) is answered 500 "Erreur base de données" and the Retry-After: 5 header is skipped ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (treat a non-query upstream status (at minimum 408/429) as upstream, then re-baseline: a 429 must answer 502 with Retry-After 5)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-units.test.mjs — supabase.ts maps an empty body to an empty array and putCache stores it with the 24 h updates TTL, so /updates is frozen as an empty list for a day even after the upstream recovers ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (treat an empty body (or a non-array data) as a fetch failure, then re-baseline: the empty generation must not be cached and the next call must refetch)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-units.test.mjs — badjunia/route.ts read() throws "statut badjunia illisible" when a service's lastCheck.up is not a boolean, and the handler's catch turns the whole payload into the all-null UNKNOWN status with X-BadJunia-Verified false ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (treat a missing lastCheck as unknown for that service only, then re-baseline: the sibling services' status must survive)

tests/logic/upstream-routes-units.test.mjs — documents/route.ts maps a token to the buffered bytes and serves them on redemption without binding the token to the requesting account, so any caller holding the one-shot 60 s token receives the document ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (seal the requesting account (or warm key) into the token and require the same session on redemption, then re-baseline: a stranger must be refused)

tests/security/probes-boundaries.test.cjs — session-manager.ts openSession returns the same jar and home when the sealed flow differs and only drops nav, so the flow label cannot be used as a security boundary ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (include the flow in the AAD (or drop the flow check and document the token as endpoint-agnostic), then re-baseline: a token sealed for another flow must not open)

tests/security/probes-concurrency.test.cjs — session-manager.ts single-flights concurrent logins for one credential key, so 3 client attempts become 1 upstream attempt and 1 strike and the brake counts upstream attempts, not client attempts ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (count client attempts (or keep the collapse and document it in the refusal contract), then re-baseline: three client attempts must be visible to the brake)

tests/security/probes-concurrency.test.cjs — session-manager.ts keys the strike counter on the salted email+password warm key, so every distinct password restarts the counter at 0 and guessing passwords for one known address is never throttled ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (key the brake on the salted email (or email + client IP), then re-baseline: the 4th wrong password for one email must be refused without an upstream login)

tests/security/probes-concurrency.test.cjs — supabase.ts dropCache deletes the inFlight entry too, so the running loader drops its value un-stored and a second caller starts a second upstream load for the same key ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (leave the in-flight promise registered until it settles and use a dropped flag to decide storage, then re-baseline: the concurrent caller must join the same load)

tests/security/probes-concurrency.test.cjs — supabase.ts answers a live entry with HIT and the entry's own expiry, so the TTL of a key belongs to the first writer and a later caller's longer TTL is silently ignored ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (re-stamp (or refuse) a hit whose requested ttlMs differs from the stored entry's, then re-baseline: the longer TTL must be honoured)

tests/security/probes-concurrency.test.cjs — supabase.ts familyOf splits on the first colon, so print:jobs:* and print:balance:* are one family and a full cache evicts the oldest member of the incoming family even when an older unrelated entry is present ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (derive the family from the route namespace (the first two segments), then re-baseline: a balance write must not evict a jobs entry)

tests/security/probes-growth.test.cjs — session-manager.ts learnMenuIds writes label to menuid into one process-wide map with no credential or deployment in the key, so one account's render repoints the sidebar for every other account for 30 min ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (namespace the registry key by the upstream deployment (or warm key), then re-baseline: another account's render must not change the label)

tests/security/probes-growth.test.cjs — session-manager.ts learnMenuIds calls eraRefusals.m.clear(), so one account's successful render wipes every flow's era flag for all accounts and re-arms flows known broken ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (clear only the flags the render proves (per flow, not clear()), then re-baseline: the other flows' flags must survive)

tests/security/probes-growth.test.cjs — session-manager.ts keys eraRefusals by flow name only, so one account's reduced-menu error disables the flow for every account for 10 minutes with no upstream retry ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (scope the era flag to the deployment, then re-baseline: another account must still be allowed the flow)

tests/security/probes-growth.test.cjs — supabase.ts sizeOf walks the value and never serializes it, so a value whose toJSON throws is stored at its walked size and served as a HIT; a circular object would overflow the stack in sizeOf ; assertion re-baselinée, le défaut est corrigé (validate the payload before putCache (routes only store parsed JSON), then re-baseline: the payload must not be cached)
